mission_09: Excellent! You have implemented Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search that optimizes network architectures for specific hardware targets. Your NAS system generates candidate architectures, evaluates them against hardware constraints (parameters, latency, memory), and scores them using a multi-objective function that balances accuracy with deployment requirements. The Pareto frontier identifies architectures that offer the best trade-offs between competing objectives. This approach is essential for edge AI deployment: a model that achieves 99% accuracy but takes 100ms to run is useless for real-time applications, while a 95% accurate model running in 5ms may be perfect. Hardware-aware NAS automates this trade-off exploration, finding architectures tailored to specific deployment targets from microcontrollers to cloud GPUs.
